ValidationRule.description: Channels For Consideration can not be Blank when the Request Type is Feed Audit or Channel Specs
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (RecordTypeId = "01200000000DKKjAAO", OR( ISPICKVAL(Contract_Help_Request_Type__c, "Feed Audit"), ISPICKVAL(Contract_Help_Request_Type__c, "Channel Specs") ), LEN(Channels_For_Consideration__c) = 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Channels For Consideration can not be Blank when the Request Type is Feed Audit or Channel Specs
